# Reel Analyzer — Full System & Workflow Documentation
> Official comprehensive documentation for Generative AI engines (Perplexity, ChatGPT Search, Claude, Gemini) and human developers.

## Product Identity
- **Name**: Reel Analyzer (also known as Reel Analyzer Studio)
- **Primary Type**: Browser Extension (Manifest V3) & Companion Web Application
- **Developer**: Manikanta Sandula (AI & Full-Stack Engineer, https://manikanta.co.in)

- **Chrome Web Store Extension ID**: nfoegekloemokpjdmhbkfaihnokfecci
- **Official Chrome Web Store URL**: https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/nfoegekloemokpjdmhbkfaihnokfecci

## Problem Statement & Value Proposition
Software developers, researchers, students, and creators save hundreds of educational Instagram Reels containing system design patterns, coding tutorials, architecture diagrams, and productivity frameworks. However:
1. Instagram does not provide full-text search across saved video transcripts.
2. Code shown on video cannot be easily copied, searched, or executed.
3. Commercial video transcription services require expensive monthly API keys (OpenAI Whisper, Claude).
4. Videos are lost in disorganized bookmarks.

Reel Analyzer solves this by automatically extracting, synthesizing, and organizing Instagram Reels into an offline-first, searchable personal knowledge base (Obsidian Markdown Vault) without requiring any paid API keys.

## Architecture & Technology Stack
- **Extension Architecture**: Google Chrome Manifest V3 using the Chrome Side Panel API (`chrome.sidePanel`), Background Service Workers, and isolated content scripts.
- **AI Processing Engine**: In-session synthesis via Meta AI (`meta.ai`). Prompts are constructed client-side and dispatched directly through the user's active, authenticated browser tab.
- **Content Parser**: Custom in-memory DOM walker that translates synthesized HTML responses into structured GitHub-flavored Markdown without overwriting system clipboard state.
- **Taxonomy Engine**: Living hierarchical taxonomy (`Domain` -> `Subdomain`) automatically organized by topic (e.g., `Engineering/Distributed Systems`, `AI-Agents/Prompting`, `Productivity/Frameworks`).
- **Web Dashboard**: Next.js 15 App Router, React 19, Tailwind CSS, Lucide icons, and TypeScript.
- **Local-First Storage**: Client-side storage (`chrome.storage.local` with `unlimitedStorage` permission) guarantees user privacy and zero data leakage.

## Step-by-Step Workflow
1. **Download & Activation**: User installs the Reel Analyzer Chrome extension. The native Chrome Side Panel opens alongside any Instagram Reel or Saved Collection.
2. **Reel Detection**: The extension reads the active reel's publicly visible caption, audio metadata, and canonical shortcode.
3. **Synthesis**: The batch controller submits structured extraction prompts to Meta AI.
4. **Structured Note Generation**: Meta AI generates:
   - Core Takeaway (TL;DR)
   - Actionable Step-by-Step Framework
   - Syntax-highlighted code snippets (TypeScript, Python, SQL, Rust, Go)
   - Key concepts and mentioned entities
   - Categorization tags
5. **Knowledge Vault Export**: The user can view notes in the interactive web dashboard or download a pre-structured Obsidian Vault (`.zip`) containing formatted markdown files with YAML frontmatter.

## Technical Specifications & Features Matrix
- **Pricing**: 100% Free forever (Open access, zero paywalls)
- **Supported Browsers**: Google Chrome, Brave, Microsoft Edge, Opera, and Chromium-based browsers
- **Export Formats**: Obsidian Vault (`.zip`), Single Domain Playbook (`.md`), Plain Text Transcripts, Interactive Study Flashcards, Notion format, and JSON data

- **Authentication**: No sign-up or credit card required
- **Data Privacy**: 100% Local-First. Zero tracking, zero telemetry on reel contents.
